race.title: 1664 Biere Open NH Flat Race (GBB Race)
race.verdict: JIMMY GATZ is well worth another chance to build on his strong debut form having probably found testing conditions against him at Ffos Las when last seen (Flat bred). Bateleur went down fighting on his Rules debut at Sedgefield last month and his excellent attitude is sure to stand him in good stead again, while the selection's stablemate, Hannah's Kitchen , is the pick of the newcomers before market clues. JIMMY GATZ (FR) BATELEUR (IRE) HANNAH'S KITCHEN (IRE)
